summary: SMOKE run for CI selector-validity-gate integration into frontend export:web chain. All 4 requested checks PASS. Gate artifact and package.json wiring verified. Rebuilt static export serves 200 at both localhost:3000 and external URL. Welcome page loads at 1920x800 with 0 page errors and content rendered (bodyLen=16809, 40+ data-testid selectors present). Mobile 390x844 shows zero horizontal overflow (docScroll=390, innerWidth=390) — previous responsiveness fix intact in new bundle. Admin login (admin@realaicoach.app) succeeds — navigates from /auth/login to authenticated dashboard shell with 'Welcome back, RealAICoach!' resume modal and full sidebar (Home / Features / FPS Game / Flappy Bird / Watch Videos / Audio Studio / Podcasts / Sports / Travel Visa / etc.). No pageerrors on any tested route. Build-chain change did not alter app behavior.

desktop_welcome_1920x800.notes: 40+ welcome-* testids rendered; hero, nav, progress-map, quick-nav all visible

critical_code_review_comments: package.json export:web chain is a very long single-line command (line 11) with 11 sequential gate scripts followed by METRO_MAX_WORKERS=1 export. Consider splitting into a shell script or Makefile target for readability and easier CI failure attribution, but not blocking.

The selector-validity-gate.js scans app/ + src/ .ts/.tsx/.css looking for a second attribute inside [data-testid="..."] selectors — good targeted regex; recommend also scanning .js/.jsx if any are still authored (currently only .ts/.tsx/.css) to future-proof.

Direct navigation to /login (no /auth prefix) redirects to /welcome — this is expected because canonical login route is /auth/login. If any legacy links/tests still hit /login they will land on welcome (soft redirect); not a bug for this iteration.
